ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.18.1 is a stutter-focused RimWorld 1.5 performance playtest. Runtime profiling identified JobGiver_Work -> GenClosest -> Reachability/RegionTraverser as the dominant main-thread spike chain. V0.4.18.1 therefore adds a JobGiver-scoped nearest-first layer directly on GenClosest.ClosestThing_Global and ClosestThing_Global_Reachable for non-prioritized searches. Spawned in-range candidates are ordered by exact squared distance with stable source-order ties; Vanilla still owns Reachability, WorkGiver predicates, reservations and the final Job result. This allows the original GenClosest distance gate to stop invoking expensive predicates after a nearer valid target is found. V0.4.18 ReachProfile positive confirmation remains fail-safe, Harvest hard-negative Work prefiltering remains active, and Path worker results remain shadow-only while SafePathClass evidence is collected. Workers never create Jobs, reserve targets or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map state.
